title: Control characters in actual transport errors break the persisted JSON metrics contract

evidence.kind: executed actual Kotlin production consumer + strict independent JSON decoder
evidence.behavior: 30 of 32 U+0000..U+001F error characters produce rawMetrics rejected by Python json.loads; LF/CR are escaped. Actual status remains INSTRUMENT_FAILED.

impact: Failure record reaches downstream consumers with invalid JSON; parsing/replay/export cannot reliably read failure evidence. No claim that a real user record was damaged.
requirement_source: LEM-Workbench/ENGINEERING_RULES.md: failure is data, inspectable results
Task A continuation stages 2 and 3: failures, preservation, codec/runtime distinction
R42 exception 2/4 permits a correct standard JSON serialization mechanism
interpretation: This is a broken serialization mechanism, not a forbidden literal. Escaping rules belong to code under R42; do not externalize JSON grammar as configurable policy.
recommendation: Serialize error metrics with the existing JSON library or a complete JSON escaping mechanism; preserve error information without turning failure into success.

alternatives.name: JSON library DTO/map serialization
alternatives.status: available dependency, not used for rawMetrics here

target_data_graph_object: Failed run evidence / metrics payload, with source error and exact recipe reference; no requirement to colocate artifact bytes in graph storage.
acceptance_test: Run lem/run.py --phase acceptance; LEM-009-JSON-CONTROL-CHAR must preserve every U+0000..U+001F value through strict JSON decoding. Android storage/reload remains a separate gate.
migration_risk: Old malformed records cannot be assumed valid; classify unreadable payload explicitly and preserve original bytes. Never silently rewrite unknown historic evidence.

r42_exception.reason: Standard JSON escaping is algorithm/serialization contract. Bug is failure to satisfy that contract.
